화염 오라와 마그마 갑각을 두른 최종보스 데몬
> A towering, invincible demonic magma final boss with a moderately muscular build, side view combat idle animation. Crown of massive sweeping curved obsidian horns, with a magnificent, radiant pillar of intense golden-orange and crimson fire billowing and undulating dynamically from the head in a fluid loop. Reinforced demonic physique featuring jagged obsidian carapace plates, layered spiked shoulder ridges, and thick hardened sinew with heavy armor-like fleshy protrusions; deep crimson lava veins pulse through cracked basalt skin down to a flowing, molten-magma robe pooling at the floor. Periodic bursts of intense hellfire actively flare and spiral around the body in a rhythmic cycle with floating embers, radiating an untouchable, god-like boss aura. Heavy breathing idle stance, sharp clawed gauntlets idling at sides, no held weapon. Clean bold outline, limited palette, chibi 3-head proportions.
>
